briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-frontier AGI capabilities race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid surging compute investments. Regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents while multi-agent security gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic unveiled Claude 4.5 Opus; Google DeepMind dropped Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI pushed Grok-3; DeepSeek-R2 claims parity with o3. Reasoning benchmarks show 18% gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $40B Stargate expansion; TSMC 2nm yields ramp for Blackwell; Saudi Arabia commits $25B to AI data centers; Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k scale.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a closed Western lab or an open Chinese consortium by 2028?
